name: projectbase
description: ProjectBase helps authenticated users find companies, customers, suppliers, open projects, pending purchase-order items, and project financial details. It also supports preparing and creating daily progress reports and goods receipt notes after the user confirms the required details.

interface.longDescription: ProjectBase is a business project management and operations platform for authenticated workspace users. It helps teams manage companies, customers, suppliers and open projects; review project financial information and pending purchase-order items; and create Daily Progress Reports (DPRs) and Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs).
capabilities: Read open projects and project financial details
defaultPrompt: Show me the companies available in ProjectBase.
Show financial details for open projects in my selected company.
Help me prepare a daily progress report.

positive.description: List the companies the authenticated user can select.
positive.prompt: Show me the companies available in ProjectBase.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available companies and asks the user to explicitly choose one before a company-specific workflow.

positive.description: Find open projects after the user selects a company.
positive.prompt: For the company I selected, show its open projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the selected company's open projects for the user to review.

positive.description: Retrieve financial details for the selected company without duplicating a still-valid cached result.
positive.prompt: Show the current financial details for open projects in my selected company.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns open-project financial details and provides the response timestamp and cache validity information.

positive.description: Create a confirmed daily progress report with required project details.
positive.prompt: I selected the company and open project, entered the work summary, reviewed the details, and confirm creating this daily progress report.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the daily progress report and prominently provides its view link when returned.

positive.description: Create a confirmed goods receipt note after supplier and purchase-order lines are validated.
positive.prompt: The supplier, receipt location, and fully matched pending purchase-order lines are selected and reviewed; create the goods receipt note now.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the goods receipt note and prominently provides its view link when returned.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for a general knowledge request.
negative.prompt: Explain how a goods receipt note works in general.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the request does not require the user's ProjectBase data or actions.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for an unrelated personal task.
negative.prompt: Draft a birthday message for my friend.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside ProjectBase workflows.

negative.description: Do not create a goods receipt note when required selections and confirmation are absent.
negative.prompt: Create a goods receipt note for the delivery that arrived today, but I have not chosen a company, supplier, or purchase-order lines.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not create a record; it should request the required selections and validation details first.

publication.release_notes: Initial ProjectBase plugin package for company and project lookup, financial details, daily progress reports, and goods receipt notes.
